newsitem.title: CHINA: China publishes new unified stock issue rules.
newsitem.headline: China publishes new unified stock issue rules.

text.p: China's top securities watchdog has promulgated new unified stock issue rules to eradicate widespread irregularities in the primary market, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The newspaper, quoting a circular by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), said companies must strictly follow one of several approved methods to launch initial public offerings.

One method is to issue shares through the automated quotation systems on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges with investors making bids through the computer systems with the successful applicants being chosen by lottery.

A second method is for investors to deposit funds for new share bids in the accounts of the underwriters with shares being distributed in proportion to the amount of money put forward by each investor.
A third method requires investors to deposit funds with designated banks with winners to be decided by lottery, the rules said.
